_law: Learning Law (Law 8) + Validation Gate Law (Law 13). A system that only records winners cannot learn from its reasoning. A pipeline that does not mutate from completed projects is relying on memory.
_note: This is not a notes file. Every finding must trace to a specific permanent mutation — a file change, a schema addition, a law update, a pipeline version bump. Observations without mutations are not learning. They are archaeology.

failure_trace._instruction: For every failed review question: trace to the upstream artifact that failed to constrain the condition. Do not record the failure as a prompt problem unless the prompt is the actual source. Most failures trace higher.

pipeline_mutations._instruction: Every finding that should change the pipeline permanently goes here as an explicit file edit. Not an observation — an edit. If you are recording something without a corresponding file_path and change, it is not a mutation.
